name: Skyvern
summary: Open-source browser automation that uses AI to fill forms, log in and extract data across websites.
description: Skyvern automates repetitive browser work such as logging into portals, filling forms, downloading invoices and extracting data. It uses AI to read pages, so it does not rely on fixed selectors that break when sites change. The core is open source. The hosted service has a free plan with 5,000 credits per month, a Hobby plan at $29 per month and a Pro plan at $149 per month; it supports 2FA and lists HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance.

howToUse.title: Open Skyvern
howToUse.description: Open Skyvern and choose Start Building on the hosted service, or use the open-source core. Skyvern automates repetitive browser work.

howToUse.title: Describe the workflow
howToUse.description: Describe the run you want: logging into portals, filling forms, downloading invoices or extracting data from the pages. It also supports 2FA.

howToUse.title: Let it read the page
howToUse.description: Skyvern reads the pages, so you do not depend on fixed selectors that break when sites change. The hosted service lists HIPAA compliance. A free plan includes 5,000 credits each month. Hobby costs $29 a month and Pro costs $149.
